description: This file defines an immutable Java class called ImmutableJsonPointer that implements the JsonPointer interface. It provides functionality for parsing, constructing, and manipulating JSON pointer objects, including methods for adding levels, appending sub-pointers, navigating levels, and converting to string representations.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonPointer
classes.description: An immutable implementation of a JSON pointer, representing a sequence of JSON keys with methods for parsing, extending, and retrieving hierarchical parts.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance representing an empty JSON pointer.

methods.name: ofParsed
methods.description: Parses a character sequence into an ImmutableJsonPointer, supporting various input formats.

methods.name: addLeaf
methods.description: Returns a new JSON pointer with an additional level/device for a given JSON key.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends another JsonPointer to this pointer, creating a combined hierarchical path.

methods.name: getLevelCount
methods.description: Returns the number of levels in the JSON pointer.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks whether the JSON pointer has any levels.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the JSON key at a specific level, if present.

methods.name: getRoot
methods.description: Returns the root JSON key if available.

methods.name: getLeaf
methods.description: Returns the last JSON key in the hierarchy.

methods.name: getSubPointer
methods.description: Returns a sub-pointer starting from a specified level.

methods.name: getPrefixPointer
methods.description: Returns a prefix pointer up to a specified level.

methods.name: cutLeaf
methods.description: Returns a new pointer without the last level.

methods.name: nextLevel
methods.description: Returns the next immediate level as a JsonPointer.

methods.name: toFieldSelector
methods.description: Converts this pointer into a JsonFieldSelector object for field-based operations.
